contracts.purpose: Preserve governing authority boundaries when a component computes, validates, recommends, transports, or executes a function.
Keep canonical semantic ownership singular and explicit across mirrors, projections, providers, consumers, implementations, dependencies, co-location, execution, and scope changes.
Govern how subordinate policy or contracts may extend canonical law without weakening or replacing it.
Bind admission and semantic-class promotion to the exact subject evaluated and to the authority that owns the target class.
Preserve the non-authoritative status and source relationship of artifacts produced from upstream semantics.
Bind an evidence or receipt claim to the exact subject, coordinates, criteria, and outcome it attests so the claim can be independently checked.
Separate normative requirements, implementation state, and assurance claims and define when stronger assurance language is permitted.
Preserve unknown, unresolved, and conflicting semantics and constrain degraded behavior so unavailable capabilities cannot silently impersonate other semantic owners.
Keep applicable hard constraints outside compensating optimization or preference logic.
Bind derived validity to resolvable authoritative inputs, transformations, and governing coordinates.
Separate semantic identity from representation and provider choice while requiring explicit compatibility across semantic boundaries.
Preserve admitted historical meaning by representing correction and change as successor or supersession rather than in-place semantic rewrite.
Define projection as a bounded source-derived view that may select or reshape representation without creating new meaning or authority.

Keep validation and conformance observational, bind them to correctness criteria independent of the candidate and its production path, prevent validators from changing candidates or governing criteria, and make success depend on complete, evidence-bound evaluation of every applicable required criterion.
Preserve the distinction among capability declaration, admission, availability, authorization, and invocability.

Classify an L9 product by its canonical consumption and deployment boundary without inferring kind from implementation technology, repository shape, semantic complexity, or incidental process topology; an exactly bound admitted product-kind exception is the only departure from that classification.
Define the authoritative ProductTopology contract from which every L9 product is compiled using one shared topology vocabulary, while preserving product-owner semantics and kind-specific obligations.
Translate an admitted ProductTopology and governing semantics into a typed, provenance-preserving requirement closure without losing hard obligations or manufacturing missing requirements.

outcomes.ambiguous: multiple materially distinct semantic closures remain without canonical selector

contracts.purpose: Resolve capability closure, architecture obligations, and required ports from authoritative requirements while preserving ownership, compatibility, hard constraints, and explicit uncertainty.

outcomes.ambiguous: multiple admissible bindings remain without canonical selection rule

contracts.purpose: Bind resolved semantic ports and realization requirements to declared technologies only when registered capability facts and compatibility contracts prove the realization admissible.

outcomes.incompatible: requested conformance binding cannot faithfully realize obligation

contracts.purpose: Derive proof obligations from governing semantics before implementation and hand executable realization of those obligations to the independently owned conformance system.

Define the proof-carrying derived ProductManifest that binds one exact authoritative ProductTopology to its fully resolved requirement, capability, architecture, port, adapter, relationship, technology, provider, admission, lifecycle, and conformance closure before implementation lowering.
Define the identity dimensions and bindings every ProductTopology may declare without conflating product, runtime, actor, surface, provider, adapter, or governance-profile semantics.
Resolve dynamic runtime, constellation, actor, and surface identity from bounded runtime evidence under one canonical resolver contract and preserve Unknown rather than guess.
Define the typed provenance-bearing evidence artifact by which resolved identity is propagated to bootstrap, governance, memory, receipts, evidence, and observability consumers.

Govern progression of an exact L9 product release candidate through validation, compatibility proof, admission, publication, distribution, currentness, supersession, and retirement by composing the applicable canonical product, identity, validation, compatibility, admission, lifecycle, provenance, conformance, and distribution semantics without redefining or absorbing the semantics owned by those contracts.
requires: required_consumer_reconciliation_or_binding_evidence_is explicit when consumer acceptance is part of release completion

contracts.purpose: Govern objective-relative quantitative Strategic Value assessment without transferring Numerical Reasoning, business policy, planning authority, or execution authority to a projection or consumer.
Govern model-conditioned analysis of adaptive actors without creating value semantics, authoritative facts, a fourth reasoning owner or action permission.

Govern a consumer's interaction-conditioned evaluation using GT response semantics and the independently admitted l9.contract/strategic-value-assessment@1 plus l9.strategic.value@1. GT does not own valuation, create an SV model, or grant plan or execution authority.

Decide whether a set of domain projections selected by one domain consumer binding can be used together at the requested governing coordinates, without synthesizing, reconciling, or promoting any selected meaning.

Keep every composition of domain projections independently traceable to its exact inputs, the profiles and binding that selected them, the contracts that governed composition, and the engine that produced it, and make it non-current when any of those coordinates changes.
